records.jp: 二人で入るには、狭いと思うんだけど
records.en_original: Looks like it's a little tight for the both of us.
records.en_auxiliary: Looks like it's a little tight for the both of us.
records.en: Looks like it's a little tight for the both of us.

records.jp: そう？　こんなもんじゃない？
records.en_original: You think? Isn't this just what camping is like?
records.en_auxiliary: You think? Isn't this just what camping is like?
records.en: You think so? Is this not about normal?

records.jp: あ、ごめん
records.en_original: Ah, sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, sorry.
records.en: Ah, sorry.

records.jp: なんでそっち向いてるのー？
records.en_original: Why are you looking away?
records.en_auxiliary: Why are you looking away?
records.en: Why are you looking away?

records.jp: ……近すぎるから
records.en_original: You're too close...
records.en_auxiliary: You're too close...
records.en: You're too close...

records.jp: なんだか避けられてるみたいで寂しいなぁ
records.en_original: Aww... You don't like me?
records.en_auxiliary: Aww... You don't like me?
records.en: Aww... You don't like me?

records.jp: そういうわけじゃ……！
records.en_original: That's not...!
records.en_auxiliary: That's not...!
records.en: That's not...!

records.jp: ふふ、ひっかかった～
records.en_original: Hehe, gotcha!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, gotcha!
records.en: Hehe, gotcha!

records.jp: そう言われたら余計近づきたくなっちゃうよね
records.en_original: Well that just makes me want to get closer to ya!
records.en_auxiliary: Well that just makes me want to get closer to ya!
records.en: When you say that, it only makes me want to move closer.

records.jp: ちょ、ちょっと！
records.en_original: H-hey!
records.en_auxiliary: H-hey!
records.en: H-hey!

records.jp: へっへっへ、もっと近づいちゃおっと
records.en_original: Hehehe, and a little bit closer!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehehe, and a little bit closer!
records.en: Hehehe, and a little bit closer!

records.jp: 調子に乗らないの！
records.en_original: Don't get carried away!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't get carried away!
records.en: Don't get carried away!

records.jp: はーい……
records.en_original: Okaaaaay...
records.en_auxiliary: Okaaaaay...
records.en: Okaaaaay...

records.jp: でも、ちょっと慣れてきたかも
records.en_original: I think I'm starting to get used to it.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I'm starting to get used to it.
records.en: I think I'm starting to get used to it.

records.jp: 私のおかげ？
records.en_original: Thanks to me?
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks to me?
records.en: Thanks to me?

records.jp: そうじゃなくて、良さがわかってきたの。<CR>この空間の
records.en_original: No. I mean I'm starting to understand the appeal of this kind of space.
records.en_auxiliary: No. I mean I'm starting to understand the appeal of this kind of space.
records.en: That is not what I mean. I am starting to understand<CR>what is good about this space.

records.jp: 持ち運びできる部屋っていいよね
records.en_original: Having a room we can carry around anywhere is pretty cool, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Having a room we can carry around anywhere is pretty cool, huh?
records.en: Having a room we can carry around anywhere is pretty cool, huh?

records.jp: うん。自分の場所を確保するって、<CR>外だと中々大変でしょ？
records.en_original: Yes. It's quite difficult to have a place just for yourself on the outside.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. It's quite difficult to have a place just for yourself on the outside.
records.en: Yes. Securing a place of your own<CR>is quite difficult outdoors, is it not?

records.jp: たまにはこうやって喧噪から距離を置くのも<CR>大事だと思う
records.en_original: I think it's important to get away from things every now and again.
records.en_auxiliary: I think it's important to get away from things every now and again.
records.en: I think it is important to distance yourself from the bustle<CR>like this from time to time.

records.jp: ねー。元の世界に戻っても、学校でキャンプしたいなぁ
records.en_original: Same. I wanna try camping on campus when we get back home.
records.en_auxiliary: Same. I wanna try camping on campus when we get back home.
records.en: Same. I wanna try camping on campus when we get back home.

records.jp: それは距離を置くというか置かれそうね
records.en_original: I'm not sure if that counts as getting away from things.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not sure if that counts as getting away from things.
records.en: I'm not sure if that counts as getting away from things.

records.jp: 狭いところって落ち着くよね
records.en_original: Small spaces like this are kinda comfy, don't you think?
records.en_auxiliary: Small spaces like this are kinda comfy, don't you think?
records.en: Small spaces like this are kinda comfy, don't you think?

records.jp: 違……いや、そうかも。<CR>広いところではこんな安心感覚えたことないし
records.en_original: Not really— ...Actually you may be right. I don't think I've ever felt this sense of security in a wide open space.
records.en_auxiliary: Not really— ...Actually you may be right. I don't think I've ever felt this sense of security in a wide open space.
records.en: Not really— ...Actually you may be right.<CR>I don't think I've ever felt this sense of security in a wide open space.

records.jp: かといって、不用意にベタベタされるのは嫌だけど
records.en_original: Though I do dislike it when people are a bit too clingy.
records.en_auxiliary: Though I do dislike it when people are a bit too clingy.
records.en: Though I do dislike it when people are a bit too clingy.

records.jp: はいはい、わかってるよ～
records.en_original: All right, all right. I get it.
records.en_auxiliary: All right, all right. I get it.
records.en: All right, all right. I get it.

records.jp: 星崎さんはどこでキャンプしてみたい？<CR>学校は抜きで
records.en_original: Where would you want to camp? Other than on campus.
records.en_auxiliary: Where would you want to camp? Other than on campus.
records.en: Where would you want to camp, Hoshizaki-san? Somewhere<CR>other than school.

records.jp: 山の麓とか？
records.en_original: In the mountains I guess?
records.en_auxiliary: In the mountains I guess?
records.en: In the mountains I guess?

records.jp: 私もせっかくするなら、そういうところでしてみたい。<CR>あまり今まで山と縁がなかったから
records.en_original: I think I'd like to go somewhere like that as well. I've never been to the mountains much.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I'd like to go somewhere like that as well. I've never been to the mountains much.
records.en: I think I'd like to go somewhere like that as well.<CR>I've never been to the mountains much.

records.jp: コッヘルで温めたコーヒーを飲みながら、<CR>日の出を見たりして
records.en_original: I would watch the sunrise as I drank coffee made on a portable stove...
records.en_auxiliary: I would watch the sunrise as I drank coffee made on a portable stove...
records.en: We could watch the sunrise while drinking coffee<CR>heated in a camping pot...

records.jp: それって、私と一緒に「夜明けのコーヒー」<CR>飲みたいってこと？
records.en_original: You mean after a night of white hot passion?
records.en_auxiliary: You mean after a night of white hot passion?
records.en: Does that mean you want to have “coffee at dawn”<CR>together with me?

records.jp: 違います
records.en_original: No.
records.en_auxiliary: No.
records.en: No.

records.jp: 海辺かな。伶那さんはやったことある？
records.en_original: The beach sounds good. Have you done that, Rena?
records.en_auxiliary: The beach sounds good. Have you done that, Rena?
records.en: The beach sounds good. Have you done that, Rena-san?

records.jp: ない。少し歩けば家に帰れるのに、<CR>なんでキャンプしないといけないの？
records.en_original: No. Why would I camp somewhere so close to my house?
records.en_auxiliary: No. Why would I camp somewhere so close to my house?
records.en: No. Why would I camp somewhere<CR>so close to my house?

records.jp: それもそうかぁ
records.en_original: I guess you're right...
records.en_auxiliary: I guess you're right...
records.en: I guess you're right...

records.jp: でも、他所から来るならいいと思う。<CR>潮の音を聞きながら寝るとか
records.en_original: Though I wouldn't mind doing it somewhere else. Falling asleep to the sound of the waves does sound nice.
records.en_auxiliary: Though I wouldn't mind doing it somewhere else. Falling asleep to the sound of the waves does sound nice.
records.en: But I think camping at a beach somewhere else would be nice.<CR>Falling asleep while listening to the waves, for example.

records.jp: いいねえ。その時は伶那さんも一緒に泊まろうね
records.en_original: Mmm, sounds great. I can't wait till we go.
records.en_auxiliary: Mmm, sounds great. I can't wait till we go.
records.en: That sounds great. When the time comes, let's stay there together, Rena-san.

records.jp: 聞いてた？　さっきの話
records.en_original: Were you even listening to me?
records.en_auxiliary: Were you even listening to me?
records.en: Were you even listening to me?

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
